question: Related Questions Q. You have an answer regarding photography where it is not permitted. But still now, there are debates about its permissibility. I would like to know what are the latest views of large number of Scholars (based on all 4 schools of thoughts) regarding photography of living and non-living things. 5299 views Q. Asslamoalaikum.
